act.name: Prevention of Money-Laundering Act, 2002
act.source_authority: Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
act.description: Central law preventing money laundering and governing attachment, adjudication, confiscation, investigation and reporting obligations.

sections.title: Offence of money-laundering.
sections.text: Section 3 defines the offence of money laundering in relation to proceeds of crime; consult the linked official text for the complete provision.
sections.plain_language_summary: Specified involvement with proceeds of crime, including concealment, possession, acquisition, use or projecting them as untainted, can constitute money laundering.
